definitions.explanation: Without any delay. As a free-standing adverb before a verb it is casual and punchy ({即|そく}{決|き}めた, "decided on the spot"); it also forms many compounds with the same meaning, such as {即日|そくじつ}, {即答|そくとう}, {即席|そくせき}.
Between two nouns, A {即|そく} B says that A is the same as B or leads straight to it. Formal and written; most often negated: A{即|そく}Bではない, "A does not automatically mean B."

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即|そく}⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{気|き}に{入|い}った→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{即|そく}⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a place I liked, so I decided on it the very day I viewed it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即|そく}⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Silence is not the same as consent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{即|そく}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Having a good education doesn't automatically mean being highly capable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{即|そく}⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながるような⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people object to strict rules under which a single failure leads straight to expulsion.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 as a bare adverb is informal; in polite or written Japanese use ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧ or ⟦{即座|そくざ}→即座：11861_sokuza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. In compounds it is neutral and very common.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧: the same day
- ⟦{即答|そくとう}→即答：11939_sokutou⟧: immediate answer
- ⟦{即決|そっけつ}→即決：18490_sokketsu⟧: prompt decision
- ⟦{即席|そくせき}→即席：11826_sokuseki⟧: instant, improvised (⟦{即席|そくせき}→即席：11826_sokuseki⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧)
- {即|そく}レス: instant reply (internet slang)

WRITING:
{即|すなわ}ち (namely, that is) uses the same kanji but is a separate word.
